summary: MCP connector review follow-up (#1422): templates of a tool call are read against the branch the other templates' readings choose, whatever the order of their names; the save-time argument check follows if/then/else, anyOf, oneOf and not along the whole failure path ($ref into $defs included) and judges a branch whose choice reads only literals; a tools/list is cached per the token that read it, so a new OAuth sign-in never gets the previous user's catalog or readOnlyHint; BeginAuthorization re-checks the server under the row lock and discovers again when it changed. The automations module now gives its engine the connector directory, so only x-secret credential fields are masked in call output and errors (an MCP output that echoes the server URL or auth kind stays as its schema checked it).
